'''Menahu''' was the native language of the [[Menahuun]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]]. Menahuun rarely learned to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="R">{{GamerCite|7|Reckonings}}</ref>

Known words and expressions in Menahuun included ''[[ORO Mining Station LM0228|Hua'Bal]],'' meaning "Hidden Glory" (used as the name of his community).<ref name="R" />

[[Byrch Dyshkava]] learned to speak Menahu during the several decades he spent as a [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] of the Menahuun.<ref name="R" />
